title: "Figure 5"
---

```{r}
sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"&
              str_detect(sc$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type,"^Ex|Ery",negate = T)))
gc()
sc$has_LA<-ifelse(sc$LA_per_Sample>0,"LA+","LA-")
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_remove(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type," \\(.+"))%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_replace(nosub,"Memmo","Memo")%>%str_remove("Early "))

temp<-read_csv("data/myeloid_subgroups.csv")
aux_table<-sc@meta.data%>%rownames_to_column("barcode")
aux_table<-temp%>%select(barcode,myeloid_cl)%>%
    right_join(aux_table)%>%
    mutate(nosub=ifelse(!is.na(myeloid_cl),
                        myeloid_cl,nosub))%>%
    select(-myeloid_cl)
aux_table<-aux_table[order(match(aux_table$barcode,colnames(sc))),]
sc<-AddMetaData(sc,metadata = aux_table,col.name = "nosub")

```

## ARID5B
```{r}
deg<-data.table::fread("docs/hasLA_DEG_sc_newMyeloid_MAST.gz")

temp<-deg%>%filter(ct=="EnS cells")%>%
  mutate(STATUS=case_when(avg_log2FC<=-1&p_val_adj<0.05~"Low",
                          avg_log2FC>=1&p_val_adj<0.05~"Up",
                          TRUE~"Not.Sig"))
#min(temp$p_val_adj[temp$p_val_adj>0])
temp<-temp%>%mutate(p_pos=p_val_adj+p_val_adj+1e-309)
pA<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=avg_log2FC,y=-log10(p_pos),col=STATUS))+
    geom_point(size=.5)+geom_text_repel(data=temp%>%filter(STATUS!="Not.Sig")
                                 %>%group_by(STATUS)%>%
                                     slice_min(p_pos,n = 5),
                                 aes(label=gene),size=3,show.legend = F)+
    theme_classic()+theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),legend.position = "bottom")+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#2166ac", "grey", "#b2182b"))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1,linetype="dotted")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1,linetype="dotted")+
  guides(col=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=3)))+
  labs(x="LFC",y="-log10(P.adj)")   

temp<-DotPlot(sc,features = "ARID5B",group.by = "nosub",split.by = "has_LA")
pB<-temp$data%>%separate(id,into = c("ct","has_LA"),sep = "_")%>%
  filter(ct!="Myeloid cells")%>%arrange(desc(avg.exp))%>%
  mutate(ct=factor(ct,levels=unique(ct)))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=has_LA,y=ct,col=avg.exp,size=pct.exp))+
  geom_point()+scale_color_viridis_c(option = 'B',direction = -1)+
  theme_classic()+labs(x="",y="",col="Avg.Exp",size="%")

```

# Menstrual cycle
```{r}
bulk<-read_csv("data/TMM_normalised_endometrial_expression_ARID5B_IGFBP5_FOXO1.csv")
bulk<-bulk%>%
  mutate(Stage=case_when(Stage.of.Cycle==1~"Menstrual",
                                  Stage.of.Cycle==2~"Early-proliferative",
                                  Stage.of.Cycle==3~"Mid-proliferative",
                                  Stage.of.Cycle==4~"Late-proliferative",
                                  Stage.of.Cycle==5~"Early-secretory",
                                  Stage.of.Cycle==6~"Mid-secretory",
                                  Stage.of.Cycle==7~"Late-secretory"))%>%
  arrange(Stage.of.Cycle)%>%
  mutate(Stage=factor(Stage,levels=unique(Stage)))
pC<-bulk%>%ggplot(aes(x=Stage,y=ARID5B_CPM))+
  geom_boxplot()+theme_classic()+labs(x="Stage of cycle",y="ARID5B (CPM)")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,vjust =1,hjust = 1))

```

# TNFRSF18
```{r}
tnk<-subset(sc,cells = which(str_detect(sc$nosub,"T-|NK")))
temp<-DotPlot(tnk,features = c("TNFRSF18","TNFRSF4"),group.by = "nosub",split.by = "has_LA")
temp<-temp$data%>%separate(id,into=c("ct","has_LA"),sep = "_")

pF<-temp%>%filter(ct!="Myeloid cells")%>%arrange(desc(avg.exp))%>%
    mutate(ct=factor(ct,levels=unique(ct)))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=has_LA,y=ct,col=avg.exp,size=pct.exp))+
    geom_point()+scale_color_viridis_c(option = 'B',direction = -1)+
    theme_classic()+labs(x="",y="",col="Avg.Exp",size="%")+
  facet_grid(~features.plot)+theme(strip.background = element_blank())

save(pB,pC,pD,pE,pF,pG,file = "docs/Fig5.RData")
```

# GITR in cosmx
```{r}

files<-list.files()
files<-files[str_detect(files,"bg")][-1]#no endometrioma
metadata<-lapply(files,vroom::vroom)%>%bind_rows()
gc()
metadata<-metadata%>%filter(str_detect(fov_type,"CD|NK"))
mat<-vroom::vroom("endometrium.csv")%>%filter(cell_ID%in%metadata$cell_ID)
mat<-vroom::vroom("PE.csv")%>%filter(cell_ID%in%metadata$cell_ID)%>%bind_rows(mat)
gc()    

mat<-mat%>%column_to_rownames("cell_ID")%>%t()
negavg<-colMeans(mat[c("Ms IgG1","Rb IgG"),])
normi<-t(t(mat)-negavg)
normi<-asinh(normi/5)
nobatch<-sva::ComBat(dat = normi,batch = str_remove(colnames(normi),"c_1.+"),
                     BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 2))

temp<-metadata%>%select(cell_ID,dom_nEndoh1_75,Class,fov_type)
temp<-nobatch%>%t()%>%as.data.frame()%>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_ID")%>%select(cell_ID,GITR)%>%
  inner_join(temp)
temp<-temp%>%mutate(index=case_when(dom_nEndoh1_75==6~1,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==3~2,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==4~3,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==2~4,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==1~6,
                                    TRUE~dom_nEndoh1_75))#as defined in Fig2

domcol <- c( "gray13", "gold2", "lightskyblue2", "darkorange1", "plum4", "maroon")
names(domcol)<-6:1
pG<-temp%>%filter(dom_nEndoh1_75!=7)%>%mutate(Run_Tissue_name=str_remove(cell_ID,"c_.+"))%>%
    group_by(Run_Tissue_name,index,fov_type)%>%summarise(GITR=mean(GITR))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=as.factor(index),y=GITR,col=as.factor(index)))+
    geom_violin()+geom_boxplot(width=.1)+
    labs(x="Domain",y="Average GITR")+theme_classic()+
    stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",ref.group = 1)+
    scale_color_manual(values=domcol)+facet_wrap(~fov_type,nrow=3)+
    theme(legend.position = "n",strip.background = element_blank())

```
